title: ATM
description: Operate a coin: run its blockchain and distribute it.
summary: Turn this device into an ATM — a trusted node for a participation coin. Create a coin with its own keyset, assignment rules and blockchain database; distribute assigned coins to participants as a faucet (recorded on the coin's ledger); designate other npubs as trusted ATMs; and share the coin so wallets can hold it. One ATM can run several coins, each with its own rules and ledger.
